name: EX-17 Information Operations — 3 Days
description: 3-day Information Operations (Info Ops) exercise covering counter-disinformation, PSYOPS, media operations, and cyber influence activities. Working-hours schedule (0800–1800). Participants practice coordinating narrative development, counter-narrative deployment, social media monitoring, and strategic communications across a simulated complex information environment. Suitable for Info Ops staff, public affairs, and strategic communications exercises.

groups.name: OSINT & Monitoring
groups.description: Open source intelligence and social media monitoring

groups.name: PSYOPS Cell
groups.description: Psychological Operations — message development and delivery

items.title: INJECT: Disinformation Campaign Detected
items.description: EXERCISE INJECT: OSINT monitoring detects coordinated inauthentic behaviour on social media platforms: 3,400 bot accounts amplifying false narrative about friendly force activities. Narrative: fabricated atrocity claims. Source analysis indicates state-sponsored activity. Info Ops Commander briefed. T=0.

items.title: Information Environment Assessment
items.description: Info Ops Cell conducts rapid Information Environment Assessment: identifies key audiences, influencers, vulnerable populations, trusted voices, platform reach. OSINT cell maps bot network and identifies coordinating infrastructure. Assessment products distributed to all cells.

items.title: Counter-Narrative Product Development
items.description: Info Ops and Media Ops develop counter-narrative messaging package: video evidence rebuttal, factual narrative, graphic products, spokesperson Q&A preparation. Legal review of all products. Tone calibrated to target audience. Multi-language versions prepared.

items.title: Platform Takedown Requests
items.description: OSINT cell submits coordinated inauthentic behaviour reports to social media platforms (Twitter/X, Facebook, TikTok). Evidence package submitted: bot network connections, coordinated posting patterns, false narrative examples. Platform trust and safety teams notified via expedited government channel.

items.title: Press Conference — Factual Rebuttal
items.description: Official spokesperson delivers factual rebuttal at press conference. Video evidence presented. Journalists Q&A managed. Messaging reinforces core counter-narrative. Live-streamed on official channels. Social media team amplifies through verified accounts.

items.title: PSYOPS — Leaflet & Social Media Campaign
items.description: PSYOPS cell executes approved influence campaign: targeted social media content reaching key demographics, radio broadcast in disputed area, leaflet design (subject to approval for airdrop). Messages designed to reinforce friendly credibility and expose adversary deception.

items.title: Narrative Impact Assessment
items.description: OSINT cell provides 24-hour narrative impact assessment: reach metrics, sentiment analysis, counter-narrative pickup by trusted media outlets, bot network activity (reduced by 67% following platform takedowns), key audience polling data. Assessment: positive trend. Adjust messaging for Day 3.

items.title: INJECT: Adversary Escalation — Deepfake Released
items.description: EXERCISE INJECT: Adversary releases AI-generated deepfake video showing friendly force commander making false statements. Video spreading rapidly. Info Ops Commander activates rapid response protocol: authentication team analyses video, platforms notified simultaneously, spokesperson statement drafted for 15-minute release.

items.title: ENDEX
items.description: ENDEX declared. All active information operations stood down. Exercise scenario terminated. Final information environment assessment compiled.

items.title: Info Ops AAR
items.description: Exercise AAR. Topics: detection speed, counter-narrative effectiveness, platform coordination, PSYOPS product quality, deepfake response, inter-cell coordination, legal compliance. Lessons: attribution confidence needed before public rebuttal, deepfake authentication toolset required, platform response time SLAs.
